reviews.title: Great purchase. Worth it.
reviews.comment: Works as it states. Package arrived in excellent condition. Plenty of cables and zip ties for cable management. It also came with stainless steel screws. Easy to install and hook up. The installation guide was somewhat helpful which says a lot based upon a lot of guides provided by other companies.
